title: KnightOwlStudio Mod Pack
description: Mods, Shaders, and settings I use in my Hardcore Survival Series.
body: This is the setup I use in my Hardcore Survival Series—mods, shaders, and QoL tweaks that make the world look better without changing how the game plays. No cheats, no gameplay mods, just cleaner visuals, smoother performance, and my personal settings. If you want your world to look like mine, this is it.
